sources.title: GitHub - nexgen-adm/qwen3: Qwen3 is the large language model series ...
sources.snippet: Important Qwen3 models adopt a different naming scheme. The post-trained models do not use the "-Instruct" suffix anymore. For example, Qwen3-32B is the newer version of Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct. The base models now have names ending with "-Base".

sources.title: Qwen3 Complete Guide: Every Model from 0.6B to 235B
sources.snippet: Qwen3 is the best open model family for budget local AI. Dense models from 0.6B to 32B, MoE models that punch above their weight, and a /think toggle no one else has.
